menuDescription: Site links, language, theme and account actions.

account.confirmLogoutAllBody: You will be signed out here and on every other device. You can sign in again at any time.

intro.learner: This is your learning home. Your competency profile, skill gaps and learning path will appear here as those parts of the prototype are built.
intro.trainer: This is your teaching home. Your content library and quiz tools will appear here as those parts of the prototype are built.
intro.admin: This is your administration home. User management and workforce views will appear here as those parts of the prototype are built.
intro.superadmin: This is your platform home. Organisation, framework and system tools will appear here as those parts of the prototype are built.

dashboard.nextStepsHint: These areas are planned for later milestones of the prototype.

steps.competencies: See your level for each competency, with the evidence behind it.
steps.gaps: Compare your levels with what your role requires, ranked by priority.
steps.recommendations: Get suggested courses, each with the reason it was picked.
steps.path: Follow an ordered path of courses that closes your biggest gaps.
steps.content: Upload training material and keep it organised in one place.
steps.generate: Turn a document into draft quiz questions with source quotes.
steps.review: Edit, approve or reject drafted questions before learners see them.
steps.users: Invite people, set roles and manage accounts in your organisation.
steps.invites: Track pending invitations and send new ones.
steps.audit: Review a tamper-evident record of important actions.
steps.organisations: Manage the organisations that use the platform.
steps.framework: Maintain competencies, levels and role requirements.
steps.system: Check system-wide settings and integration health.

overview.title: Your overview
overview.emptyBody: Charts and progress summaries will appear here once there is real data for your account.
